idea: One sunny early-March morning after rain in the kitchen of a 1936 Portland English Tudor Revival house, shot from one locked frame, cycling through 9 range-wall layouts from a bare plaster wall with a curved plaster hood to a hammered copper hood framed by sage zellige and leaded-glass cabinets.
